title: Delete only a strategy that never sent a basket (G-16-6)
reference_behaviour: Any saved strategy can be deleted from a bin icon after a confirm that says it cannot be reversed, though the record is only archived.
ours: REQ-070 AC-6: only a never-executed draft can be deleted, with confirm and Undo; one that sent a basket reads Can't delete: orders were sent. Decided by ADR-118 (stricter).
